segments.he: פעם אחד סיפר אחד למוהרנ"ת ז"ל איך שפלוני קילל אותו השיב לו מוהרנ"ת ז"ל לא פלוני קילל אותך אלא אתה מקלל אותו מפני שסיפרת לי ובל"א "ניט יעניר האט איך גשאלטין די שעלסט איך ווייל דיא דערציילסט מיר".
segments.en: But the food was "nit gezaltsn un nit geshmoltsn" [neither salted nor rendered] — it had no taste. He said to them: "Est! Est! Es iz in drosn vi zeyer kalt — es vet zikh der voremer varemen" [Eat! Eat! It is so cold outside — the warm food will warm you]. Moharan'as ate. But Reb Nachman of Tulchin could not eat such food. Moharan'as said to him: "Po'el bay zikh — es iz gut" [Work within yourself — it is good]. He began to do so — and Reb Nachman said that he literally tasted in the food the flavors of all dishes. For the essential thing is the feeling in the mind: "Az men po'elt bay zikh es iz gut, felt men taki az es iz gut" [When one works upon oneself that it is good, one truly feels it is good].
